A closed nonexecuting static descriptor can proceed without the unanswered execution/lease numbers once its spelling and scoped obligations are reviewed; no full selector, authority or worker proof follows from current partial query machinery.

semantic_authority.owner_choice_assessment: No new business-semantic choice is required to express exactly these already accepted semantics. Compiler spelling, effect classification and narrow policy-composition review are prerequisites, not authority to revise them. A general grant, a changed recipient, different revocation/admission cut, status lookup/replay, new service/version/egress or altered lifecycle semantics would exceed this recipe and require its own concrete review/owner decision. Do not invent that expansion to unblock the narrow slice.

Its Todo.id key remains historical comparison evidence; only the scoped accepted successor changes identity. Current migration User.email and authentication_subject have empty field policies; public TodoView/UserWithTodos omit recipient email. Static binding must not silently widen those ordinary paths.

source_observations.fact: Ordinary QueryExpression has one predicate field/value and one order; QueryPage has ordered cursor fields and predicate list, but only Equal/OptionalEqual/OptionalLessEqual and no page-owned required include. Neither encodes the complete reminder selector.

User lifecycle visibility is already status==active. Existing required-parent lowering places correlated parent visibility/policy EXISTS before ORDER BY/LIMIT; it remains a one-predicate/one-order OFFSET template, not the required compound due/id keyset implementation. Its whole-record selected columns are not authority to expose User.email or other restricted fields.

Already-qualified Todo.create_todo and Todo.patch_todo are exact candidate hook owners. Create establishes unsent state; patch has optional PatchTodo.due_at and derived reminder_sent_at:none when input.due_at supplied. Hook site and supplied semantics can be checked without names-as-heuristics or general row-revision substitution.

Existing jobs bind nominal operation-time constructor, exact interval and action; grammar accepts only concurrency/run/retry. Audit is checked_nonexecuting_schedule_entries with execution_profile:null/runtime_lowering_supported:false; target explicitly rejects jobs.

Current policy structures expose role/membership bindings and operation obligations/field reads. PolicyEffect is Create/Read/Update/Delete/Invoke. Existing owned operation exceptions replace the owning entity effect rule, while field checks narrow at entity field scope. There is no delivery-qualified recipient-read/sent-only completion/job external-effect contract; a generic update or invoke label cannot establish it.

Checked external-service metadata already carries operation/request/receipt/idempotency/import/schema parity/egress/secret-slot/outcomes. Checked authentication AST carries api_bearer.service_key credential identity/principal/verifier/active/expires/revoked and service resolution. Neither metadata inventory proves a live credential, membership or immutable delivery-origin value.

required_refinements.gap: Selection needs an exact public closed AST/type contract, not a reference to a currently unsupported generic query shape or a token inventory promoted into selector proof.
required_refinements.correction: Use a delivery-only SelectionPlan with an explicit source entity/identity, strict non-null due<activation operation-time snapshot, exact open equality, source lifecycle visibility, unsent predicate, checked required owner relationship and owner lifecycle/policy visibility, ordered ascending (due,id) keyset and literal500 bound. Resolve relationship/reference/identity types from checked persistence/lifecycle declarations. Keep typed cursor shape and private continuation ownership explicit. Admission binds the same eligibility and recipient/policy obligations plus current schedule revision; no post-limit owner filtering or stale payload as admission proof.
acceptance: Static AST contains every conjunct, required-owner pre-limit requirement, due/id order and cursor types; null due and due==operation_time are ineligible by contract, due<time is eligible only with other conditions.

Negatives: omit/alter any conjunct; <= instead of<; optional owner; post-limit owner condition; bound501/dynamic/unbounded; OFFSET/single-key cursor; wrong identity/owner path; refreshed clock or scheduled_for instead of activation snapshot.

Future generated SQLite/PostgreSQL probe has>500 preceding inactive/invisible/unauthorised-owner rows and eligible later rows; owner EXISTS and all predicates precede LIMIT, ties use id and continuation does not skip/duplicate unchanged eligible rows. This is a future lowering gate, not static-pass evidence.

required_refinements.gap: A nominal Uuid wrapper and named action do not make intent, payload, receipt or completion private. Current AST has no sealed delivery context/callability kind.
required_refinements.correction: Define compiler-owned sealed kinds and origin checks for persisted intent brand, immutable payload, admitted/fenced completion context and receipt observation. Binding-local selection/completion identities are distinct nonordinary semantic node kinds, never CallableDeclaration actions/queries accepted by ordinary invocation. Accept only direct checked selection-field/config references and closed generated slots in the payload map; no arbitrary mapping calls, source aliases or source-provided fence/time/receipt. Completion can only retain exact checked receipt evidence and conditionally write the declared sent field with current fence+original schedule revision+unsent guards using compiler observation time. Provider accepted_at stays evidence. Preserve source clear:none at the exact supplied-due-date hook; forbid other authored sent-state writes, including owner actions/base-type/alias constructions.
acceptance: Positive exact imported ReminderMail.send_overdue_reminder, ReminderMessage/ReminderReceipt parity, persisted nominal ReminderIntentId body/header identity, immutable version and precise field map.

Negatives: authored ReminderIntentId(rawUuid), raw source/context/receipt objects, ordinary route/action/job call to named completion, different recipient/id/header/version, unknown payload field, mutable payload, source accepted_at sent stamp, stale-fence or wrong-revision completion; reject even with structurally compatible types or an internal-looking name.

Changing a private name does not grant authority; duplicate/ambiguous private identities fail. Ordinary provider calls are never rewritten to enqueue; without this binding they retain ordinary semantics and existing checks.

required_refinements.gap: Exact validator/role names alone do not establish obligations or revocable role provenance. Current field-policy API cannot express job/phase-qualified email reads without a deliberate checked successor.
required_refinements.correction: Define a narrow delivery-policy contract keyed by exact job+binding+phase+role+entity/field/service/completion targets. Resolve a real authoritative Service-principal membership source, not a token/header/input claim or owner role. Carry validator credentials and service-resolution active/expiry/revocation obligations separately from recipient User lifecycle visibility. Explicitly classify scan/admission role and row/field/external-effect requirements, and exact admitted completion authority/fence/revision guards. No permission to read whole User, serialise email to routes, update arbitrary Todo fields, delete/purge or call another service. Extend policy analysis for this closed context; do not shoehorn completion into generic PolicyEffect::Update or add the role to broad entity/field grants merely to compile.
acceptance: Positive checked application-scoped membership member typed Service.id, exact role variant and api_bearer.service_key; audit contains principal/credential/service/membership references and all field/effect conditions, labelled checked_contract_not_live_authority.

Negative wrong member entity, nonidentity nominal field, stale/unbound/duplicate role or validator, generated synthetic principal, user/owner impersonation, source bearer string, Access.authenticated substitute, cross-job use, extra service or ordinary email output.

Existing owner CRUD, User.email empty ordinary policy, UserWithTodos/TodoView shapes and protected policy bytes remain unchanged; paired ordinary-read/output probes still deny recipient email outside delivery context.

Worker authentication secret handoff is distinct from provider config.mail_api_key bearer sink. Audit records identities/slots, never raw credentials, config values, provider response or recipient data.

required_refinements.gap: Operation names do not specify exact mutation sites or whether the ordinary run action owns new behavior; schedule revision and enqueue must not be conflated.
required_refinements.correction: Resolve Todo.create_todo's checked create site and Todo.patch_todo's checked update site and PatchTodo.due_at supplied path by qualified name+structural site (source/range internal only). Require one unambiguous compatible site per named hook in the first closed slice; reject extra incompatible sites/calls rather than adding alias/control-flow solving. Hooks establish/advance private business schedule revision and clear sent state transactionally on success; they do not dispatch or blindly enqueue an ineligible newly created row. Selection/enqueue and later admission remain separately bound short transactions. Specify that job delivery orchestration is attached only by explicit delivery AST; ordinary calls to the run action cannot activate it. For the first static descriptor reject ordinary external-service calls/additional effects in its run body; never reinterpret one as outbox behavior.
acceptance: Successful supplied equal due advances revision; omitted due does not; failed/rolled-back patch changes neither revision nor sent state; A→B→A remains distinct. Static audit records these requirements; executable evidence is future work.

Reject ambiguous create/update hooks, incompatible field/source store, arbitrary helper callback, an unannotated alternative mutation bypassing bound schedule semantics, renamed spelling guessed by suffix, additional service calls or an atomic DB transaction encompassing HTTP.

Existing non-delivery jobs retain exactly their three clauses and nominal constructor checking. Bound jobs remain explicitly target-unsupported without a reviewed worker/profile; no inert worker registry, startup action call or no-op scheduler is emitted.

minimal_first_static_recipe.status: Concrete review candidate, not accepted grammar or authorization to implement. The first slice is parser/type/formatter/checked audit only after the required public-language/effect/policy refinements are reconciled.
public_spelling_candidate: Keep job NAME every DURATION { concurrency: singleton run: ACTION(NominalRunAt(clock.now)) retry: next_schedule ... } unchanged; propose one optional delivery: reminder_v1 { selection: {...} hooks: {...} service: {...} authority: {...} completion: {...} }.

selection keys: name: reminder_candidates; entity: Todo; identity: Todo.id; due: Todo.due_at; before: operation_time; open: Todo.status(TodoStatus.open); visible: Todo; unsent: Todo.reminder_sent_at; required_owner: Todo.owner; owner_visible: User; order_by: Todo.due_at asc, Todo.id asc; limit: 500; continuation: due_identity.
hooks keys: create: Todo.create_todo; patch: Todo.patch_todo; supplied: PatchTodo.due_at. Each resolves one checked structural mutation site; never prepend owner twice.

completion keys: name: reminder_sent; field: Todo.reminder_sent_at; time: compiler_receipt_observation.
minimal_first_static_recipe.spelling_meaning: The illustrative semicolons separate proposed closed keys; before production grammar, save the exact token grammar/duplicate+unknown-key diagnostics and formatter round-trip. selection.name and completion.name declare binding-local nonordinary checked nodes, not references to existing generic queries/actions. A separate selected-query declaration is unnecessary for this minimal candidate; if chosen instead, define the same closed selector AST and do not pretend existing QueryExpression/Page supports it. operation_time/generated_intent/compiler_receipt_observation/continuation are closed compiler-origin descriptor terms legal only here, not source values or new callable intrinsics. visible/owner_visible resolve existing lifecycle contracts. reminder_only has exactly the reviewed phase/target grant table, no implicit generic privileges.
minimal_first_static_recipe.supporting_declarations: Migration lacks the proposed job/action/ReminderIntentId/ReminderServiceMembership/ReminderRole and mail declaration. Add none in this review. A later positive fixture must explicitly declare them: ordinary job run nominal Instant→Unit contract; authoritative application membership with member:Service.id and role enum; exact pinned service declaration and request/receipt nominal contracts. Membership provisioning stays outside ordinary caller authority. Intent sealing must be implemented as a checked origin/capability restriction in this binding, not inferred from the ReminderIntentId name or UUID representation.

Extend policy/effect graph with delivery-phase/source-to-field/service/completion contracts and authoritative role source. Keep ordinary entity/field policies unchanged. Existing may-call graph, generic invoke and declaration inventory are supporting facts, not a complete delivery authority proof.

Stable semantic tuple/structural addresses; no NodeIds/offsets/private runtime identifiers or secret values. Preserve current non-delivery audit behavior.

Record runtime obligations individually as unimplemented/unproved. Keep execution_profile:null, runtime_lowering_supported:false, execution/lease numeric fields unset; optionally expose separately accepted3 invocations/1h and provider3 attempts/30s as contract facts, never as a complete execution profile.
